title: Chicken Pot Pie with Drop Biscuits
description: Tender chicken and corn bake under six small scratch biscuits in a sage gravy.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

steps.title: Dice the filling
steps.text: Dice {breast} and {potato} into ½-inch pieces. Finely chop {mush}.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.text: Simmer potatoes and mushrooms in {broth} with {sage} for 7 minutes. Add the chicken and {corn}; simmer 5–8 minutes until the potatoes yield and chicken reaches 165°F.

steps.title: Thicken the gravy
steps.text: Mix {starch} with {cold}. Stir into the bubbling filling with half of {milk} and whisk for 1 minute until thick.

steps.title: Mix the biscuit dough
steps.text: Rub cold {butter} into {ap} and {bpow}. Fold in the remaining milk just until a soft dough forms.

steps.title: Top the dish
steps.text: Allow the filling to cool to lukewarm before it goes into the room-temperature 4-qt Crispi glass dish, without the plate. Drop six small spoonfuls of dough over the filling, leaving spaces for steam.

steps.title: Bake the pie
steps.text: Fit the 4-qt adapter and PowerPod, select Bake and cook 17–25 minutes. Check the center of a biscuit for set crumb and 195°F, and the filling for 165°F. Rest 4 minutes.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the sauce a day ahead and refrigerate separately. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooked portions with sauce, cooled within 2 hours, for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: cover and warm gently with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat covered to 165°F. Dairy swap: use unsweetened oat milk and unsalted plant butter. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 444 kcal, 37.4 g protein, 47.5 g total carbohydrate, 11.6 g fat, 2.8 g fiber, 259 mg sodium.
